task: Extend budget_usage endpoint to include per-project spending rows in the user's personal spending panel, sorted by project name then type (platform -> cli -> premium).

key_reasoning.reason: No existing pattern in this codebase for combining BudgetUsageService and MemberSpendService in a single request — each lazy-refresh path issues internal DB commits (insert_budget_entries, insert_member_budget_entries) that expire ORM objects in a shared AsyncSession. The two paths must run in separate session scopes or in a defined order; no precedent exists here. Auto-bump applied: acceptance criteria enumerate graceful handling of empty per-project member assignments with no existing test template covering that defensive path.

Three components touched: analytics router (get_user_budget_usage), BudgetUsageService (extended to call MemberSpendService data), and MemberSpendService (reused as a data source). Spans API and Service layers. Requires column-schema transformation from MemberSpendService's columnar format (one row per project, one column per category) into BudgetUsageService's row-per-category layout.

Core behaviour and sort order are well-specified. Gaps: admin user_id path scope is unspecified (AC targets only the self-service path); budget_reset_at and time_until_reset fields have no equivalent in ProjectMemberBudgetAssignment, requiring a null-value convention that is not documented.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from L to XL: acceptance criteria enumerate a specific error/edge case (empty per-project member assignments handled gracefully) and no existing test template covers that defensive pattern in the budget_usage path.
